newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle feedlots quiet, no sales - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle feedlots quiet, no sales - private.

text.p: Nebraska cattle feedlot markets were at a standstill, with no sales of slaughter steers or heifers reported, market sources said.
Buyer inquiry was scattered at $103.00 per cwt on a dressed basis and $63.00 on a live basis, with bids passed by owners pricing cattle at $105.00 and $65.00, respectively, they said.

The bulk of this week's sales were at $104.00/dressed and $64.00/live on Wednesday. About 67,000 head were sold for the week to date through Wednesday, which was below this week's showlist estimate of 75,000 head, sources said.
